attempts.summary: On node1 (CentOS Stream 10), built a local package repository from packages downloaded to local storage, served it via a systemd-managed HTTP server on NODE_IP, made the real remote mirror network-unreachable and disabled the remote repo configs, then installed the "tree" package purely from the local HTTP-served repo. Restored remote reachability afterward. Completed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured baseline boot identity and service/package health, rebooted node1, confirmed the boot identity changed, and verified the package and local repo recovered post-restart.
